notes.title: New Vehicle Update And Bug Fixes
notes.content:
🔥 New Vehicle No. 12 Unleashed! 🔥
Get ready to hit the road with our latest addition—Vehicle No. 12! Whether you're racing, cruising, or causing mayhem, this new ride is built to impress.

🔧 Multiplayer Bug Fixes! 🔧
We've squashed several bugs to ensure smoother gameplay and better stability in multiplayer mode. Less lag, fewer crashes, and an overall improved experience!

📥 Update your game now and jump in! Let us know your thoughts in the comments. 🚀

notes.title: Version 3.3.3 Update Notes
notes.content:
🆕 WHAT’S NEW?
✅ New Motorcycles! 🏍️
Get ready to ride with new motorcycles added to the game! Faster, cooler, and perfect for satisfying your customers. Check them out in the garage now!

✅ Updated Map! 🗺️
Explore new areas and routes with more shortcuts, more challenges, and an even more immersive city to drive through!

✅ Hitchhiking Feature! 👥
Now you can hitchhiking your friend on multiplayer mode.

🔥 Update now and hit the road! 🔥

Let us know your feedback in the community—we’re always working to make Ojol The Game even better! 🚀

notes.content: Sometimes crash occurs when player go back to lobby and then start playing. It has been fixed in this patch.

notes.title: New Beach Map Now Available in Ojol The Game!
notes.content:
Hey, Ojol drivers!

We're excited to announce the release of a brand-new map in Ojol The Game – welcome to the Beach Map! 🏖️

Whether you're looking to relax and unwind by driving along the serene coastline or you want to race against your friends in a tropical paradise, this map has something for everyone.

Play Solo: Take a solo ride to soak in the sun, feel the breeze, and experience the calming vibes of the beach. Perfect for a little healing time after a busy day on the road.

Play with Friends: Gather your friends and explore this stunning new environment together! Challenge each other to see who can navigate the sandy trails the fastest, or just enjoy a leisurely drive as you chat and chill by the waves.

Get ready to hit the road (or the sand) and make some new memories on the Beach Map. Update your game now and start exploring!

See you on the beach! 🌊

notes.title: Ojol The Game is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

We are thrilled to announce that Ojol The Game is now live on Steam! 🎉 Get ready to dive into the exciting world of ride-hailing, where you’ll experience the daily challenges and adventures of being an ojol (motorcycle taxi) driver.

Whether you're a fan of simulation games or looking for a fresh new experience, Ojol The Game offers something unique for everyone. Don’t miss out on the fun—download it now and start your journey on two wheels!

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to hear your feedback. Happy driving!
